ConnectStartIn.title: ConnectStartIn
ConnectStartIn.description:
Where to send the landlord back to in the app once HMRC is done.

Only a path inside our own app is accepted ("/tax/2026/q2", never
"https://..." or "//evil.example"), so the callback can't be used to
bounce people to another site.

TransactionListItem.title: TransactionListItem
TransactionListItem.description:
A row in the cross-property list, with the landlord's share already worked out.

share_amount is for display. Tax totals are never built by adding these up:
they apply the share per property per category, as the tax module does.

TransactionPage.title: TransactionPage
TransactionPage.description:
One page of transactions, plus totals for everything that matches (not just this page).

money_in and money_out are at the landlord's share. money_out includes
mortgage interest, because it is money paid out, even though HMRC treats
it separately from expenses.

TransactionSource.title: TransactionSource
TransactionSource.description: Where a transaction came from. Each source is a separate way in.

TransactionUpdate.title: TransactionUpdate
